findings.title: Compose /data migration loses upgrade state
findings.remedy: Migrate named volume contents on upgrade or document manual step.

findings.title: reboots_sent counts NULL-outcome rows
findings.remedy: Exclude UNRECORDED rows from sent count.

findings.title: report() miscounts latched incidents
findings.remedy: Count latched-only; exclude acknowledged-never-latched; keep resolved.

findings.title: Restart drops runtime-only outage_rebooted flag
findings.remedy: Persist reboot attribution or re-derive on re-adopt.

findings.title: Report counts every frames_stopped as a distinct outage
findings.remedy: Dedupe by outage boundary or emit start-only events. Sol-exclusive; verified emission double-count across UNKNOWN telemetry gaps; base lacks counting.

findings.title: Global inhibition ignores peer stability
findings.remedy: Require stability duration for healthy-peer votes.

findings.title: Example binds 0.0.0.0 with unauth endpoints
findings.remedy: Restore loopback default or gate bind change on auth review.

findings.title: 65-byte probe fixture vs 64-expectation cases
findings.remedy: Fix fixture or case expectations to agree.

findings.title: Manifest validator ignores resource IDs
findings.remedy: Compare (type,name,id) in validation.

findings.title: README totals stale vs ledger
findings.remedy: Regenerate totals from ledger.

findings.title: Pair validator omits docs-fixed retail/B2B mapping
findings.remedy: Undecided: enforce mapping in runner or prove downstream registry gate covers pair evidence.

findings.title: Archive concurrency admission
findings.remedy: Undecided: contract side not located.

findings.title: LMS backend :443 vs :9443 vhost
findings.remedy: Align backend port with vhost listener.

findings.title: Epcore route has no matching vhost
findings.remedy: Add epcore vhost on :9443 or correct route.

findings.title: Self-set cookie bypasses admin login rate limit
findings.remedy: Validate session server-side instead of substring match.

findings.title: No WP HTTPS fixup behind TLS-terminating proxy
findings.remedy: Set HTTPS fixup or document wp-config snippet.

findings.title: Cart 403 without trailing-slash caveat
findings.remedy: No action: real /cart/ traffic unaffected.

findings.title: Trimmed IDs requested, raw IDs joined
findings.remedy: Join on trimmed IDs.

findings.title: Loading guard cleared before async StoreKit done
findings.remedy: Hold guard until product request completes; tag responses by catalogue generation.

findings.title: Failed refresh leaves stale purchasable options
findings.remedy: Clear options/products on discovery error.

findings.title: Duplicate catalogue keys resolve to first match
findings.remedy: Reject duplicate keys or resolve by row identity.

findings.title: Success path emits global error signal
findings.remedy: Report skipped entries via telemetry, not error channel; avoid double-report on parse failure.

findings.title: Integration tier accepts pure evidence
findings.remedy: Enforce tier match; correct bogus WIRE-01 pinning comment.

findings.title: Synthesized records default to pure tier
findings.remedy: Require explicit tier on synthesized records.

findings.title: Fixed /usr/bin/sqlite3 breaks quick gate
findings.remedy: Locate CLI via PATH with skip, or provision CLI in CI.

findings.title: Probe-path caption flag always false
findings.remedy: Thread actual caption state through probe path (pre-existing).

findings.title: CLI-tested endpoints can never show Ready
findings.remedy: Record model/key identity in CLI path or relax gate to tested URL.

findings.title: Env ASR marked Ready unprobed; default set
findings.remedy: Probe env-resolved endpoints or gate on service presence.

findings.title: Sessions survive password change
findings.remedy: Bind sessions to credential generation; rotate on password change.

findings.title: Save-test persists before probing; UI says Not saved
findings.remedy: Test before persist, or stage config until pass.

findings.title: record_qualified substitutes stored identity
findings.remedy: Record the tested identity actually probed.

findings.title: Reprocess drops has_captions
findings.remedy: Thread caption flag through reprocess path.

findings.title: Secure-cookie depends on in-app scheme behind TLS proxy
findings.remedy: Honor X-Forwarded-Proto or document COOKIE_SECURE.

findings.title: Readiness gate runs after upload copy
findings.remedy: Gate before copy/registration.

findings.title: Web follows deployed enhanced default; CLI-only lifted silently
findings.remedy: Confirm intended or restore restriction with explicit override.

findings.title: Docs promise strict dual-Ready; code exempts captioned
findings.remedy: Update docs to describe exemption.

findings.title: Network-reachable login has no throttling
findings.remedy: Add rate limiting/lockout to auth endpoint.

findings.title: Unauth settings page leaks provider/error detail
findings.remedy: Move readiness block inside operator guard; scrub error detail.

findings.title: Version-only Deno fetch breaks digest policy
findings.remedy: Pin by digest/signature.

findings.title: Single-model autofill without persist
findings.remedy: No action: trivial pre-existing quirk.

findings.title: Fail-closed refactor discards valid best
findings.remedy: Retain parsed best when only advisory field malforms.

findings.title: Source-ref lost when body normalizes empty
findings.remedy: Gate ref on original body as before.

findings.title: Docstring misstates hash trust boundary; acquisition skips check
findings.remedy: Scope docstring claims; route acquisition through _canonical_for or check recorded hash at ingestion. (Terra angle partially revised: dedup hashing itself is fine.)

findings.title: Phase-halt stability (both-model misread)
findings.remedy: No action: documented guarantee holds.

findings.title: Observe-mode simultaneity
findings.remedy: No action: intended semantics.

findings.remedy: Undecided.

findings.remedy: Undecided.
